sourceEvidence: W700 verified source and release history

defects.title: Camera can expose the underside of the world
defects.acceptance: No pointer, wheel, restored pose, transition or device layout can place the camera or target below the safe world floor.

defects.title: Restored and transition poses are not globally sanitized
defects.acceptance: Non-finite and out-of-bounds positions fail closed to a safe in-world pose without automatic travel.

defects.title: Projects, Atlas, NEXUS and City lack one explicit foreground state authority
defects.acceptance: All four surfaces can consume immutable projections of one canonical state without a second store or private payload copy.

defects.title: No single reviewed gateway covers cross-surface foreground navigation and selection
defects.acceptance: Every supported action requires explicit preparation and final confirmation and performs no external side effect itself.

defects.title: Flagship Expanse discovery and entry are not obvious or reliable
Wide views expose sparse disconnected district islands
NEXUS reads as transformed 2D UI rather than a primary spatial command field
Repeated continue and active-project surfaces create clutter
Atlas is not useful when no project is selected
Command Centre is not yet the unified master operating room
Home, Create, Projects, Library, Vault, Automations, Local AI, NEXUS and City do not expose one explicit product-custody and foreground-state contract
defects.acceptance: All product routes project one selected project and one EONBOT identity; Projects owns ordinary work, Library reusable content, Vault sensitive material, Creator attachments are explicit, and provider readiness is clear without copying secrets.

defects.title: Identity, billing, referral and legal surfaces need one explicit operational truth authority
defects.acceptance: Google identity remains optional and separate from backup; Dodo and signed server events own entitlements; EONKEYS remain non-cash individual unlocks; active routes contain no revived wallet, NFT, token or earnings claims.

defects.title: Institutional performance budgets and canonical binary-store proof are not consolidated
defects.acceptance: Low, balanced and high budgets are explicit; W649 source/public binaries are exact one-copy mirrors with no build duplicates; service-worker update remains explicit; real browser/device measurements are required before certification.

defects.title: Institutional keyboard, semantic-alternative, language-direction and device-layout proof is not consolidated
defects.acceptance: All critical journeys retain keyboard/pointer/touch/controller/typed-voice parity, 48 px targets, visible focus, reduced-motion and caption support, semantic alternatives for NEXUS/Atlas/City, 11-language and Arabic RTL truth, with real assistive-technology and device evidence required before launch.
